comments.author: @Globallife.documentary
comments.text: Living on $110 a month while queueing three hours for basic bread would break most of us.

replies.author: @Reallifeinsights.tv26
replies.text: Thank you so much for watching and sharing such a grounding reflection. For many of us who remember simpler or leaner times decades ago, there is a deep understanding of what it means when communities must lean on each other just to survive.
